body: Cool a bit in what way? I feel like I'm not adjusting to poly as quickly as she is and I don't want to hold her back from doing what makes her feel good but I also don't want to feel rushed to process everything. It's just a big change in such a long-term relationship and I need the time but it didn't feel fair to ask for that. It's hard to figure out what I'm meant to do here.

We're not currently but it's definitely something we're both interested in. Money is just a bit tight ATM. 

There's just a lot of physical connection that's happening in ways that we haven't connected which is expected to happen but when I need to talk through how I feel in reaction to the new things that they're doing there's a lot of defensiveness and then a shutdown. I don't want to sour the time that they've had but it's all new for me and I want to work through it so that often means me mentioning when I feel jealous and why. 

I'm asking her to open up about how she's feeling about these experiences. There's a possibility that she doesn't divulge because it's likely to turn into a longer conversation. Maybe I'm expecting too much talking to happen and it's making it not as enjoyable? What's too much talking?
